items.name: CryptoLens
items.description: CryptoLens is an educational CLI tool designed to help users understand various encryption methods and their underlying principles. It provides step-by-step visual explanations of different encryption algorithms and their processes, making cryptography concepts more accessible and easier to understand.

items.name: ConceptLens

items.name: ConceptLens-AI
items.description: ConceptLens AI is an AI-powered learning system that focuses on identifying students’ conceptual gaps rather than just marking answers as correct or incorrect. It uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), FAISS vector search, and Google Gemini to analyze questions and student responses.

items.name: ConceptLens
items.description: Students often receive only a “right” or “wrong” result without understanding why they made a mistake. ConceptLens AI identifies the underlying misconception and its root cause, recommends targeted prerequisite learning, and reassesses the student to measure improvement
